thread:
Asha (Partnerships): Vendor asked to align a single HW roadmap note for H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. They want a unified calendar but SI asks for staggered rollouts per region due to cert windows. Need a plan.
Ben (Infra): APAC has delayed B200 firmware; vendor ETA 4-7 days. MI300 driver update queued; could change marketplace manifest strings (e.g., MI300 vs MI300A).
Lina (Marketing): If manifest changes, localized listings will be wrong. We need canonical SKU strings by Thu or we freeze copy to family names.
Tom (SI): SI requests a lab dry-run per region: NA first, EU second, APAC last. Driver signing and snapshot tests are blockers for APAC.
Asha (Partnerships): Proposal: single public announce date, region availability footnotes + "rolling availability" tag. Vendor to provide signed SKU list + any hotfix artifacts by Wed.
vendor-bot: Vendor reply: signed SKU list attached; hotfix artifact for Gaudi published: https://vendor.example/patches/gaudi-hotfix-2026-04-02.tar.gz.
Ben (Infra): Got the artifact. Rebuild estimate: 24-36h after we pull signed container. Will run CI smoke for NA/EU tomorrow.
Lina (Marketing): Locking copy to family names until we have canonical SKUs confirmed. Preparing neutral headline and visuals.
Tom (SI): Scheduling dry-run: NA Mon 09:00 PT, EU Tue 08:00 CET, APAC Thu 10:00 SGT. SI will bring test accounts.
Asha (Partnerships): Action items: Vendor - confirm SKU canonical strings and signed containers by Wed; Infra - CI rebuild + smoke; Marketing - freeze localized copy; SI - run dry-runs per schedule. Follow up in meeting tomorrow 16:00 PT.
vendor-bot: Meeting scheduled: partnerships/hw-roadmap-sync 2026-04-03T23:00:00Z.
Lina (Marketing): Noted. Will mark marketplace entries as "rolling availability" to avoid hard dates.
Ben (Infra): If firmware microcode slips, label affected nodes as "derated" to prevent SLA mismatch.
Asha (Partnerships): Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after CI smoke and vendor confirmation.
